queries.query: Bajil Yemen cadastral map parcel registry land survey official
queries.result: First-party discovery did not find a Bajil-local public cadastral viewer or parcel API. It identified Yemen's official land-registry law page and a Yemen Central Statistical Organization GIS center, but these are general legal/GIS information rather than a verified Bajil parcel service.
